  "memo":"Only R02 holds, establishing Linkage. The device's 960.615-hour tenure does not qualify for the household exception; no other rule holds and no earlier outcome settles the order. Ordinary review falls under §6.6(b), requiring id_check. That check failed, so §5.3(b) now decides: escalation is standard with Linkage present, though decline is also permitted. Household sharing remains a possible explanation for the linkage, but it cannot override the failed check. Recommend escalation; the unshipped order can be voided and refunded. No further check is needed to decide the disposition."
